title: Badge Shows Real Count
description: The little red count on the bell is the first thing a user checks — it needs to appear only when there's something unread, and disappear cleanly once there isn't.
successCondition: For a user with zero unread notifications, the bell button shows no count badge at all (no element with an aria-label ending "unread"); for a user with unreadCount > 0, a badge is visible with aria-label="<N> unread" where N exactly matches the unreadCount value from GET /api/notifications.
hints: Trigger an unread notification by booking a shipment as a customer (shipment.booked notifies the booker) — allow for the async delivery delay documented in docs/api/notifications.md before checking.
The badge is conditionally rendered on unreadCount > 0 — an implementation that renders an empty badge for 0 would still be a bug worth catching.
